title: UnfoldCRF: Structured Mask Refinement with Image-Conditioned Latent Regions
mechanism: Refinement as unrolled damped mean-field inference in a CRF with corrected unaries, learned local pairwise terms and image-conditioned latent regions; compared against capacity-matched black-box refiners.
adaptation: Multiclass CRF refiner on the 24-class output; pairwise terms for crack/inactive borders, region terms for whole-region inactive errors. Its matched-control protocol should be used for every refiner arm in our benchmark.
min_experiment: Arm: UnfoldCRF refiner. Control: recurrent black-box refiner with the same parameters and stages. Metrics: inactive IoU, crack IoU, fraction of cells made worse on 5-fold CV. Kill: arm not better than control by >= 0.01 inactive IoU.
evidence: R: COD10K +1.0 F-beta-w over strongest matched control; images made worse 11.7% -> 8.5%; train-once over five datasets +4.2 mean delta-IoU vs +2.0 for control; +2.0 vs +0.6 on unseen mask generators.
